news.detail: The veteran kicker made field goals from 38, 48 and 28 yards in the first half and is in the midst of a career-best season. He's now 18-for-19 on field-goal tries and has made all 17 PATs through 10 games. Kicking in one of the lower-scoring offenses in the league, it still doesn't translate to much
